title: Polish Yautia Bake with Italian Twist
description: A delicious Italian-inspired dish with the addition of yautia and polish flavors. This bake is perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: Peel and chop the yautia into 1-inch cubes.
Cook the polish sausage in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the olive oil, garlic, and chopped yautia to the pan and cook until the yautia is tender.
Stir in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with parmesan cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the yautia is tender.
Sprinkle with parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
